name: Push to SolidCraft
description: One toolbar button sends the board to SolidCraft: mask, silkscreen, traces, pads and 3D parts, in a new tab.
description_full:
A button in the board editor that saves the board and opens it in SolidCraft (an open-source parametric CAD program) in about 8 seconds, the way Eagle could push a board to Fusion. The board comes in looking like the real thing: solder mask, silkscreen, top and bottom copper, pads, holes and every component with a 3D model. Everything but the bare board is light display geometry, so the board stays quick to work with inside a larger mechanical design. It also writes a single 3MF copy with every colour for dropping into other designs.

One way only: nothing comes back to KiCad.

Needs SolidCraft 0.18.3 or later and the solidcraft-kicad converter (https://github.com/fpoussin/solidcraft-kicad), with kicad-cli on the PATH. Tested on Linux; macOS and Windows untested.
